title: Quality Studio in-process analysis core package
summary: Implementation dossier for the AgentOrchestrator.CodeQuality NuGet boundary. It inventories the existing core, API, two CLI hosts, and Angular client; implements a named in-process analysis facade and real quality-cli caller; moves Agent Studio HTTP handover and starter rule content out of the core; answers that the core is useful without the UI; and recommends keeping it in this repository until release-cadence, zero-PR versioning, public-source, and operational ownership criteria justify extraction.

decisions.question: Is the analysis core useful without the Quality Studio UI?
decisions.answer: Yes. Agent Studio pipeline step AGT-2655, quality-cli, and CI are standalone in-process consumers.

decisions.question: Should the core be extracted into its own repository now?
decisions.answer: No. Keep the NuGet boundary in this repository until independent release cadence, zero-PR package promotion, public-repository policy, consumer pressure, and operational ownership criteria are met.
